definitions.explanation: So real or recent that it is unpleasant or painful to see or remember: fresh wounds, graphic descriptions, raw memories of a disaster.

examples.japanese: {生々|なまなま}しい⟦{傷跡|きずあと}→傷跡：14893_kizuato⟧。
⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{生々|なまなま}しい。
examples.english: The memory of the accident is still vivid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生々|なまなま}しく⟦{語|かた}り→語る：01930_kataru⟧、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}った→静まり返る：14630_shizumarikaeru⟧。
examples.english: He described his war experiences in graphic detail, and the hall fell silent.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生々|なまなま}しい⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧: a vivid, painful memory
- {生々|なまなま}しい⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: a raw wound
- {生々|なまなま}しく⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ / ⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to describe graphically
- {生々|なまなま}しい⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧: an all-too-real story

USAGE:
Unlike English "vivid", {生々|なまなま}しい is rarely positive: it suggests something too real, fresh or graphic for comfort. For a pleasantly vivid colour or image, use ⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧.

WRITING:
Also written {生生|なまなま}しい.

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {生々|なまなま}しくなかったら
